verdict.rationale: USCIS is a government immigration-services portal with case-status and FOIA APIs, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is outside its product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or tool-consuming capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
